name: BeepBox
description: Build layered chiptune tracks with melodies, drums, and patterns, then share a song link.
launchNotes: Songs are stored in the song URL, not your Aether profile. Copy the complete link to keep a track. The official site also offers an offline version. Aether editing and export are unverified.

name: Song Maker
description: Draw a melody and drum beat on a colorful grid, change instruments, and share the result.
launchNotes: Chrome Music Lab does not require an account and recommends Chrome. Use Song Maker's sharing controls to keep your song. Offline use and editing inside Aether are unverified.

name: Piskel
description: Draw pixel-art characters and animated sprites, with GIF and sprite-sheet export.
launchNotes: The official editor blocks framing with frame-ancestors 'none'. Open the original site in a top-level tab; another Aether iframe tab does not remove that restriction. Desktop and landscape controls are recommended. Export files regularly. Aether editing and export are unverified.

name: Kleki
description: Sketch and paint with layers, brushes, text, and image imports, then export your artwork.
launchNotes: The official app limits framing to its own origin with frame-ancestors 'self'. Open the original site in a top-level tab. Browser storage and tab recovery do not replace exported files. The provider documents offline support; Aether editing and export are unverified.

name: Blockbench
description: Create low-poly 3D models, paint their textures, and animate characters for game projects.
launchNotes: Requires WebGL. Some web import and export workflows need extra steps; model textures may need manual import. The provider offers an offline PWA and desktop app. Save model files outside Aether. Embedded editing and export are unverified.

name: Squoosh
description: Compress and resize images with a before-and-after preview while keeping processing on your device.
launchNotes: The provider says image processing stays on your device. Download the optimized file to keep it; Aether profile backups do not include images. Offline use, embedded imports, and downloads are unverified.

name: Twine
description: Write branching stories and choice-based games, then publish a playable HTML file.
launchNotes: Browser Twine has no accounts and keeps stories in that browser's storage. Clearing browser data can erase stories. Export or publish backups regularly. A desktop version is available. Offline browser use and Aether story editing are unverified.

name: TurboWarp
description: Build games and animations with Scratch-style blocks, enhanced controls, and project-file export.
launchNotes: TurboWarp cannot sign in to a Scratch account. Save projects to your computer and import them into Scratch separately if you want to publish there. TurboWarp Desktop supports offline work. The project's embed documentation covers players, not a guarantee for the full editor inside Aether.

name: MakeCode Arcade
description: Make arcade games with visual blocks or code, draw sprites, and run them in a built-in simulator.
launchNotes: Projects use browser storage, so clearing data can remove them. Download backups. The provider documents offline work after caching the editor, but new extensions and some compilation need a connection. Aether editing, simulator, and downloads are unverified.

name: GeoGebra Calculator Suite
description: Explore algebra, geometry, and 3D graphs with interactive mathematical tools.
launchNotes: Online saving and sharing can use a GeoGebra account; the official help also documents local file saving without signing in. Installed offline versions are available. Aether file saving, embedded interactions, and account workflows are unverified.

name: wide.video
description: Edit video clips, arrange audio and text on a timeline, and export a finished video in your browser.
launchNotes: The provider advertises local media processing with no signup or watermark and documents offline support. Large videos can consume substantial browser memory. Use a top-level original-site tab if file access fails inside Aether. Embedded editing, exports, and offline behavior are unverified.
